title: Shocked Emoji: Copy & Paste 😱 Surprise Faces, Emoticons & Combos
meta_description: Shocked emoji 😱 😲 🤯, typed gasp emoticons like :O, and plot-twist combo sets for jaw-drop reactions and replies. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: Screams, gasps, jaw drops, and typed :O emoticons: every degree of surprise. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: When something is genuinely unbelievable, the shocked emoji does the talking: 😱 screams, 😲 gasps, and 🤯 has its mind blown entirely. This page rounds up every shocked and surprised face, the exclamation marks that punch up a gasp, nervous and spooked expressions, typed :O emoticons, a few bug-eyed kaomoji like Σ(ﾟДﾟ), and one-click surprise combos for plot twists, gossip threads, and jump-scare reactions.
